outcome: mRNA expression of target transporters (NTCP, OATP1B3, BSEP, MRP4, MRP2, MRP3)
cohort: The study included six extremely preterm ovine fetuses (95 +/- 1 days gestational age, ~600g delivery weight) maintained on an Artificial Placenta Therapy platform for 120 hours, compared to six age-matched in utero control fetuses.
finding: A number of Nuclear Receptors (NRs) and some target transporters in the fetal liver were significantly upregulated after loss of placental-maternal support under Artificial Placenta Therapy, but this was insufficient to prevent signs of fetal liver damage.
